description_en: Queries the versions of an access policy
description_zh: 调用ListPolicyVersions查看权限策略版本列表
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager list-policy-versions --policy-type Custom --policy-name OSS-Administrator --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPolicyVersions

parameters.help_en:
The type of the access policy. Valid values:

Custom: custom policy.
System: system policy
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略类型。取值：

Custom：自定义策略。
System：系统策略
parameters.name: policy_type

parameters.help_en:
Policy Name of the access policy.

Policy Name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略名称。

长度为1~128个字符，可包含英文字母、数字和短横线（-）
parameters.name: policy_name

PolicyVersion.description_en: The version information of the access policy

items.description_en: The version information of the access policy

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the access policy version was created. The time is in RFC 3339 UTC format, indicated by Z
CreateDate.description_zh: 权限策略版本创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 时间格式，以 Z 表示 UTC

IsDefaultVersion.description_en: Indicates whether the version is the default version of the access policy
IsDefaultVersion.description_zh: 是否为权限策略默认版本

VersionId.description_en: The version ID of the access policy
